parking.title: Monthly parking
parking.endHint: Enter the first day without service. Parking through October 31 ends on November 1.
parking.historyHint: A new rate must start on a future date. Keep the existing effective date when only changing the service end.
parking.noSetup: No monthly parking is set up for this vehicle yet.
parking.defaultsHint: Used for new vehicle parking setups only. Existing rates, dates and issued invoices do not change.
parking.defaultTerms: Blank means payment is due at the start of the service period.
parking.noDebt: A monthly rate is not an amount owed. Only issued invoices and recorded payments affect the customer balance.
parking.adminOnly: An administrator must change an existing rate or service end date.
parking.stale: This vehicle changed elsewhere. Reload the latest record and review it before saving again.
parking.noCapacity: There is not enough compatible capacity for the full service interval.
parking.invalidFuture: Choose a future date after the last scheduled rate change. Existing history cannot be overwritten.
parking.saveFailed: Could not confirm the save. Your entries are kept. Check the vehicle before repeating the operation.
parking.invalidRate: Enter a USD amount with no more than two decimal places.
parking.invalidEnd: The end date must be after the start date.
parking.invalidEffective: The rate date must fall within the service period.
parking.invalidAnchor: Enter a whole day from 1 to 31.
parking.endReview: Changing the end date changes parking entitlement, not existing debt. Check issued invoices and handle any credit or refund separately before confirming.
parking.endBeforeArchive: End this vehicle's monthly parking before deactivating it. Its history and any debt will be kept.

payments.title: Payments received
payments.customerHint: Choose the payer. Inactive customers can still pay existing debt.
payments.referenceHint: Check number, transfer reference, or another useful identifier.
payments.offlineReceipt: Only record money already received outside OceanLink. This does not charge a card or transfer money.
payments.unallocatedHint: This receipt will remain available customer credit until staff applies it to invoices. No invoice will be marked paid automatically.
payments.saved: Payment recorded. The customer balance and last payment have been updated.
payments.offline: You are offline. Recording and corrections are unavailable until you reconnect.
payments.lotUnavailable: Could not load the lot's time zone. Retry before recording a payment.
payments.customerRequired: Please choose the customer who paid.
payments.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero, with up to two decimal places (maximum $9,999,999.99).
payments.invalidDate: Please enter a valid receipt date.
payments.futureDate: The receipt date cannot be in the future at the parking lot.
payments.validationFailed: The receipt was not recorded. Check the customer, amount and date. Your entries have been kept.
payments.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action. Ask an administrator.
payments.csrf: For safety, this request was not accepted. Reload the page before trying again.
payments.keyConflict: The server could not match this operation safely. Check the payment history and contact support before recording it again.
payments.unknown: The result is not confirmed yet. Your entries are kept and locked. Choose Check result before recording another receipt; do not refresh or close this page.
payments.unknownReverse: The correction result is not confirmed. Choose Check result to reconcile the same operation; do not create another correction.
payments.invalidRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.
payments.reverseWarning: Only reverse a payment that was recorded incorrectly. This undoes the receipt and any associated allocations, restores balances, and keeps its history. It does not refund or move money.
payments.reversed: The incorrect receipt was reversed. Balances have been updated; no money was refunded.
payments.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed. Reload to see its current history.
payments.stale: This receipt changed elsewhere. Reload and review it before correcting anything.
payments.reverseFailed: The reversal was not accepted. Your reason has been kept. Review the current receipt before trying again.

billing.dueAfter: Customer amount due after available credit
billing.applyCredit: Apply {{amount}} of existing credit to these charges
billing.issued: Monthly charges issued. Outstanding balance updated.
billing.nothingToBill: No unbilled parking periods through this date.
billing.reviewHint: Periods are billed in advance. End dates are exclusive. Issuing creates invoice charges, not a new payment.
billing.uncertain: The result is not confirmed. Check the result before issuing again; your original request will be reused.
billing.changed: The parking details, balance or billed periods changed. Reload and review a fresh preview before issuing.
billing.failed: Could not issue charges. Review the preview and try again.

account.hint: Balances come from issued invoices and recorded payments. Vehicle rates alone do not create a debt. Last payment excludes reversed payments and opening credit.
